annotations.title: Post to a HighLevel Social Planner

description: Put a post into this brand's HighLevel sub-account Social Planner: an image or video (a Library id L0… or any public https link) plus a caption. accountIds (from list_highlevel_social_accounts) is required even for a draft. status 'draft' (the default) saves it in the planner for the agency to review and nothing is published; status 'scheduled' publishes at scheduleAt (ISO, at least a minute ahead). It never publishes immediately. The post is read back from the planner before this answers. Free (no credits).

accountIds.description: Social Planner account ids, required (also for a draft)

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to, for THIS CALL ONLY (beats the connection’s pin): an id or exact name from list_brands. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

mediaUrls.description: public https image/video links to attach

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

name: post_to_highlevel
